DINNER
OSTRA invites you to explore the vibrant and 
traditional ﬂavors of Southeast Asia.
While tradition is at the heart of our menu, 
some dishes are reimagined, 
blending local ingredients with Southeast Asian 
staples to create something familiar yet distinct.
Enhance your meal with selections from our 
Sushi Bar, featuring the ﬁnest local catch crafted into 
delicate creations.
